sql: with lf as ( select split_part(f.market_ticker,'-',1) ser, f.market_ticker tk, f.side, f.action, f.price, f.quantity, f.fee::float fee, f.filled_at from fills f where f.market_ticker like 'KXNFL%' ), lo as ( select lo.strategy, split_part(lo.market_ticker,'-',1) ser, lo.market_ticker tk, lo.status, lo.limit_price, lo.quantity, lo.created_at from live_orders lo where lo.market_ticker like 'KXNFL%' ), pt as ( select pt.strategy bk, split_part(pt.market_ticker,'-',2) contest, pt.market_ticker tk, pt.pnl::float pnl, pt.closed_at cl, case when pt.side='no' then 100-pt.assumed_price else pt.assumed_price end ypx from paper_trades pt where pt.status in ('settled','closed_sl') and pt.market_ticker like 'KXNFLSPREAD-%' ), perbook as ( select bk, contest, count(*) m, count(*) filter (where pnl<0) lm, sum(pnl) p from pt group by 1,2 ) select 'J_live_fills'::text sec, coalesce(ser,'-')||'/'||coalesce(side,'-')||'/'||coalesce(action,'-') k, count(*)::text a, sum(quantity)::text b, round(avg(price)::numeric,1)::text c, round(sum(fee)::numeric,2)::text d, min(filled_at)::date::text e, max(filled_at)::date::text f from lf group by 2 union all select 'K_live_orders', coalesce(strategy,'-')||'/'||coalesce(ser,'-')||'/'||coalesce(status,'-'), count(*)::text, sum(quantity)::text, round(avg(limit_price)::numeric,1)::text, '', min(created_at)::date::text, max(created_at)::date::text from lo group by 2 union all select 'L_book_contest_max', bk, count(*)::text, max(m)::text, round(avg(m)::numeric,1)::text, round(sum(p)::numeric,2)::text, sum(lm)::text, max(lm)::text from perbook where bk in ('mmsell10','Lmmsell10','Cmmsell10','Dmmsell10','mmsell9','mmsell5','Gmmsell0','Gmmsell1') group by 2 union all select 'M_day', cl::date::text, count(*)::text, count(distinct tk)::text, count(distinct contest)::text, round(sum(pnl)::numeric,2)::text, count(*) filter (where pnl<0)::text, round(avg(ypx)::numeric,1)::text from pt group by 2 union all select 'N_band_trade', case when ypx<=7 then 'a_<=7' when ypx<=11 then 'b_08-11' when ypx<=20 then 'c_12-20' else 'd_21+' end, count(*)::text, round(sum(pnl)::numeric,2)::text, count(*) filter (where pnl<0)::text, round((100.0*count(*) filter (where pnl<0)/count(*))::numeric,2)::text, round(avg(ypx)::numeric,2)::text, round(avg(pnl) filter (where pnl<0)::numeric,3)::text, '' from pt group by 2 order by 1,2
purpose: KXNFLSPREAD: real-money exposure, per-book contest concentration, daily shape
